body.p: Please amend the claims as follows:
body.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A satellite system including a set of at least three satellites in a formation, wherein the formation includes at least three satellites arranged in a multi- satellite formation supporting continuous beam steering operations for at least one of collecting observation data from an event in the sky and tracking and continuously collecting observation data from a moving object whose observation data currently is collected whereat least two observation antenna arrays of at least two separate satellites in the setmulti-satellite formation are directed in mutually different directions and at least one of the satellites in the setmulti-satellite formation comprises a propulsion system, and
wherein the satellite system comprises a control system configured to dynamicallyand continuously change the configuration and shape of said multi-satellite formation- and thereby the combined radiation pattern of the observation antenna arrays of said at least two separate satellites for improved tracking and beam steering operations by controlling the propulsion system of at least one of the satellites in the setmulti-satellite formation by sending commands to the propulsion system of at least one of the satellites in the setmulti- satellite formation at least partly based on observation data collected by at least one of the observation antenna arrays of the at least one of the satellites in the combined radiation pattern of the setmulti-satellite formation to thereby change at least the relative angle directions of the radiation lobes of the observation antenna arrays of at least two separate satellites in the multi-satellite formation for improved tracking and beam steering operations in that the combined radiation pattern of the observation antenna arrays of at least two separate satellites in the multi-satellite formation thereby is dynamically and continuously changed and adapted to at least one of collected observation data from an event in the sky and tracking the movements and observation requirements of the for tracking an object whose observation data is currently collected.
2. (Currently Amended) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein at least two of the satellites in the set multi-satellite formation each comprises at least one observation antenna
U.S. Application No. 17/994,731
array arranged with antenna elements configured to continuously collecting observation data from at least one of the space and earth, and wherein each of said at least two satellites further comprises at least one side antenna array arranged with antenna elements configured to at least one of transmit observation data collected by an observation antenna array to at least one adjacent satellite in the formation and receive observation data collected by an observation antenna array from at least one adjacent satellite in the formation.
3. (Currently Amended) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein the control system is configured to receive or obtain at least one of space and earth observation data collected by at least one of the satellites in the set multi-satellite formation, and wherein the control system is further configured to control the propulsion system of at least one satellite in order to change the movement of said at least one satellite at least partly based on at least one of sky and earth observation data collected by at least one of the at least three satellites in the setmulti-satellite formation.
4. (Currently Amended) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein the control system of the satellite system is configured to control the propulsion system of at least one satellite in the set multi-satellite formation at least partly based on observation data collected by at least one of said at least two antenna arrays of at least two separate satellites in the set multi- satellite formation.
5. (Currently Amended) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein the control system of the satellite system is configured to control the propulsion system of at least one satellite in the multi-satellite formation set at least partly based on observation data in combination with pre-known knowledge in terms of previously acquired observation data and/ artificial intelligence.
6. (Currently Amended) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein the satellite system comprises at least one sensor and the control system is configured to control the propulsion system of at least one satellite in the set multi-satellite formation at least partly based on sensor data obtained by the at least one sensor.
U.S. Application No. 17/994,731
7. (Currently Amended) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein the satellite system comprises at least one sensor and the control system is configured to control the propulsion system of at least one satellite in the set multi-satellite formation at least partly based on obtained sensor data obtained by the at least one sensor.
8. (Currently Amended) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein the propulsion system of the at least one satellite comprises an electrostatic engine using electrostatic actuation for changing the movement and direction of movement of the at least one satellite to thereby change the configuration and shape of the satellite formation including at least one of the relative distances between the satellites in the set multi-satellite formation and the relative angle directions of the radiation lobes of at least two antenna arrays of at least two separate satellites in the formation.
9. (Currently Amended) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein at least two of the satellites in the set multi-satellite formation comprises at least one observation antenna array configured to be capable of continuously collecting observation data from at least one of the sky and the earth, and wherein each of said at least two satellites further comprises at least one side antenna array arranged and configured to transmit observation data collected by an observation antenna array to at least one adjacent satellite in the formation simultaneously with said continuous collection of observation data by said at least one observation antenna array of the same satellite.
10. (Currently Amended) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein each of said at least two satellites in the set multi-satellite formation comprises at least one observation antenna array and at least one side antenna array which are arranged and configured so that the arrangement direction, or radiation direction, of the antenna elements of said at least one observation antenna array and the arrangement direction of the antenna elements of said at least one side antenna array are directed in mutually different directions, thereby being arranged to mitigate interference problems to enable for the simultaneous sharing of collected observation data with the continuous collecting of observation data.
U.S. Application No. 17/994,731
11. (Original) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein the antenna elements of said at least one observation antenna array and the antenna elements of said at least one side antenna array are arranged and directed in mutually different directions in that the antenna elements of said at least one observation antenna array are arranged on a first surface whose normal axis over the surface areas of said first surface where the antenna elements are arranged is directed at an angle relative the normal axis of the surface areas of a second surface of the same satellite onto which the antenna elements of said at least one side antenna array are arranged.
12. (Original) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein the antenna elements of said at least one observation antenna array are arranged on said first surface so that the normal axis over the surface areas of said first surface where the antenna elements are arranged is directed at an angle relative the normal axis of the surface areas of a second surface of the same satellite onto which the antenna elements of said at least one side antenna array are arranged is within an angle range of 60-120 degrees.
13. (Original) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein the antenna elements of said at least one observation antenna array and the antenna elements of said at least one side antenna array are configured and arranged on said first and second surfaces, respectively, so that the normal axis over the surface areas of said first surface where the antenna elements of said at least one observation antenna array are arranged is directed at a constant angle relative the normal axis of the surface areas of said second surface of the same satellite onto which the antenna elements of said at least one side antenna array are arranged.
14. (Currently Amended) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein each of said at least two satellites in the set multi-satellite formation comprises at least two observation antenna arrays which are arranged and configured so that the antenna elements of a first observation antenna array and the antenna elements of a second observation antenna array are directed in mutually different directions, thereby being arranged to mitigate interference problems to
U.S. Application No. 17/994,731
enable for the simultaneous collecting of observation data by the at least two observation antenna arrays.
15. (Currently Amended) The satellite system according to claim 1, wherein the antenna elements of a first observation antenna array and the antenna elements of a second observation antenna array of the same at least one satellite in the set multi-satellite formation are arranged and directed in mutually different directions in that the antenna elements of said first observation antenna array are directed at an angle relative the arrangement direction of the antenna elements of said second observation antenna array.
16. (Currently Amended) A method for dynamically controlling the configuration and shape of a multi-satellite formation of a satellite system according to claim 1, said method is comprising:forming a combined radiation pattern involving the radiation from at least one observation antenna array of at least two separate satellites in the multi-satellite formation;
collecting, by the combined and continuously changing radiation pattern fromat least one of said at least two satellites each comprising at least one observation antenna array,
observation data from at least one of space and earth;receiving, by the control system, said observation data from at least one of the satellites in the multi-satellites formation; and
controlling, continuously by said control system, the propulsion system of at least one of the satellites in the set multi-satellite formation at least partly based on said received observation data by sending commands to the propulsion system to thereby change at least the relative angle directions of the radiation lobes of the observation antenna arrays of at least two separate satellites in the multi-satellite formation and the combined radiation pattern from the observation antenna arrays of at least two separate satellites for improved tracking an beam steering operations in that the combined radiation pattern of the antenna arrays of at least two separate satellites in the multi-satellite formation thereby is adapted to at least one collected observation data from an event in the sky and the movements and observation requirements of the for tracking an object whose observation data is currently collected.
U.S. Application No. 17/994,731
17. (Currently Amended) The method according to claim 16, wherein said satellite system is further comprising at least one sensor for detecting radiation sensor data in space and said method is further comprising:detecting, by said at least one sensor, radiation sensor data;
obtaining or receiving, by said control system, said radiation sensor data detected by said at least one sensor; and
controlling, by said control system, the propulsion system of at least one of the satellites in the set multi-satellite formation at least partly based on said received radiation sensor data.
18. (Currently Amended) The method according to claim 16, wherein said method is further comprising controlling the propulsion system of at least one satellite in the set multi-satellite formation at least partly based on observation data in combination with pre-known knowledge/artificial intelligence.
19. (Currently Amended) The method according to claim 16, further comprising controlling, by the control system, the propulsion system of at least one of the satellites in the set multi- satellite formation at least partly based on said collected observation data to change the movement and direction of movement of the at least one satellite to thereby change the configuration and shape of the satellite formation including at least one of the relative distances between the satellites in the set multi-satellite formation and the relative angle directions of the radiation lobes of at least two antenna arrays of at least two separate satellites in the formation.
